persona: Fintech specialist fund evaluating infra and API-first businesses.
use_case: Stress-test thesis parsing, startup matching, and the Ask assistant on compliance-heavy, API-led narratives.
thesis_raw: Series A fintech infrastructure and embedded payments in the US and Europe; we like API-first platforms with bank or processor partnerships and SOC2 in progress or complete.
sample_chat_prompts: What diligence topics are unique to payments infra vs. lending?
How should I weigh regulatory risk for a Series A payment orchestration API?
Draft three diligence questions on unit economics for a usage-based pricing fintech infra startup.

demo_notes.mock_mode: Use this thesis on the Thesis page for a quick end-to-end UI walkthrough; mock pipeline returns the same illustrative companies with your thesis text embedded.
demo_notes.live_mode: Expect discovery and scoring to emphasize fintech/infra signals when external data and LLM are enabled.
